item.title: Iran live updates: Vance heads to Islamabad for Iran talks
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: WATCH: Prices surged in March after oil shock set off by Iran war
item.summary: Inflation surged in March after an oil shock triggered by the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, government data showed on Friday. The inflation report matched economists' expectations.

item.title: Artemis II live updates: Crew splashes down in Pacific Ocean after historic mission
item.summary: Artemis II is carrying a four-person crew on a 10-day journey around the moon.

item.title: Melania Trump adviser speaks on what led to her surprise Epstein statement
item.summary: A senior adviser to first lady Melania Trump said she wanted to "set the record straight" when she delivered a surprise statement denying any ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: WATCH: Trump says Iran doing 'very poor job' of allowing oil through Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: President Trump accused Iran of violating its agreement with the U.S. over the Strait of Hormuz, saying on Thursday that it was "doing a poor job" of allowing oil to pass through the waterway.

item.title: WATCH: Young men in U.S. to be automatically registered into military draft
item.summary: The U.S. plans to roll out a system by December that automatically registers young men for the military draft, a policy signed into law by President Trump last year.

item.title: New renderings released for Trump's proposed 'triumphal arch'
item.summary: New rendering were released Friday for the 250-foot-tall 'triumphal arch" President Donald Trump wants to build near Arlington National Cemetery and the Lincoln Memorial.

item.title: WATCH: Crew splashes down in Pacific Ocean after historic mission
item.summary: The Artemis II crew has successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean after a historic 695,081-mile, 10-day journey around the moon and back.

item.title: WATCH: Dog helps his grandma in the garden
item.summary: Barbara, 96, is getting a helpful paw from Chewy the Newfoundland, who digs the perfect hole for planting flowers.

item.title: Offset released from hospital, shares new statement after shooting
item.summary: The rapper was shot outside a casino in Florida on April 6.
